name: Naamah
overview: The name Naamah appears in Scripture with distinct references: she is noted as the sister of Tubal-cain, a skilled craftsman in brass and iron (Genesis 4:22). Additionally, Naamah is identified as an Ammonitess who became a wife of King Solomon and the mother of King Rehoboam, highlighting her role in the Davidic lineage (1 Kings 14:21, 14:31; 2 Chronicles 12:13). Furthermore, Naamah is also the name of a city within the territory of the tribe of Judah (Joshua 15:41), indicating its geographical significance in Israel's history.
